The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: to have to have something.

draft.emotion: earnest and focused, expressing a genuine requirement for something
notes: Can be followed directly by a noun ('Necesito ayuda') or by an infinitive verb ('Necesito descansar').

senses.definition: To require something or have to do something because it is essential or very important.

examples.text: Necesito un paraguas porque va a llover.
examples.translation: I need an umbrella because it is going to rain.
examples.emotion: a bit worried about getting wet, looking for a solution

examples.text: Necesito descansar un poco antes de seguir.
examples.translation: I need to rest a little before continuing.

draftBefore.emotion: earnest and focused, expressing a genuine requirement for something
notes: Unlike 'tener que' which implies an obligation to perform an action (have to), 'necesitar' is used when you are lacking something necessary, such as an object or a resource.
It is a regular -ar verb in the present tense.

senses.definition: To require something because it is necessary or useful.

examples.text: Necesito un paraguas porque va a llover.
examples.translation: I need an umbrella because it is going to rain.
examples.emotion: a bit worried about getting wet, looking for a solution

senses.definition: To have to have something; to be unable to function without a specific thing.

examples.text: Necesito mi café de la mañana para despertar.
examples.translation: I have to have my morning coffee to wake up.
examples.emotion: slightly desperate and craving, emphasizing importance

faults.why: Mexican Spanish has seseo (/s/), not /θ/, and cannot mix both in 'necesitar'.

faults.quote: 'necesitar' is used when you are lacking something necessary, such as an object
faults.why: False restriction: 'necesitar' is also very commonly followed by an infinitive verb.

faults.quote: To have to have something; to be unable to function
faults.why: Sense 1 is the exact same meaning as sense 0, just used hyperbolically.
